title: S-Rolling: Steerable Rolling Gaits for Twistable Snake Robots in Low-Clearance Environments
title_zh: S-Rolling：面向低净空环境下可扭转蛇形机器人的可转向滚动步态
abstract: Snake robots can traverse complex environments with limbless locomotion, but maneuvering in low-clearance environments remains challenging because a gait must maintain a small swept height while also providing planar steering. Existing rolling gaits preserve a low swept height body configuration but generally provide limited steering, whereas steering gaits often introduce vertical undulation and require additional clearance. With that in mind, this paper develops S-rolling, a steerable rolling gait that combines low swept height locomotion with planar maneuverability for twistable snake robots. S-rolling is designed using an S-shaped planar backbone curve, whose head and tail segments roll with independently controlled angular velocities, producing different motion modes. We derive its joint space gait equation, in which a central twist joint realizes the relative rotation between the two segments. We also develop a quasi-static kinematic model relating the segment rolling speeds to the linear and angular velocities of the robot. Real-robot experiments demonstrate the various motion modes, traversal through a 10 cm clearance test track, and maneuvering tasks beneath a large workpiece and a car chassis. In these low-clearance scenarios, S-rolling successfully performs approximately 90$^\circ$ and 180$^\circ$ heading changes, whereas the baseline rolling arc gait cannot change the robot heading.
abstract_zh: 蛇形机器人能够以无肢运动穿越复杂环境，但在低净空环境中的机动仍具挑战性，因为步态必须保持较小的扫掠高度，同时提供平面转向能力。现有的滚动步态保持了较低的扫掠高度身体构型，但通常转向能力有限；而转向步态往往引入垂直起伏并需要额外净空。为此，本文提出了S-rolling，一种结合低扫掠高度运动与平面机动性的可转向滚动步态，适用于可扭转蛇形机器人。S-rolling基于S形平面骨干曲线设计，其头部和尾部段以独立控制的角速度滚动，产生不同的运动模式。我们推导了其关节空间步态方程，其中中央扭转关节实现两段之间的相对旋转。我们还开发了一个准静态运动学模型，将段滚动速度与机器人的线速度和角速度关联起来。真实机器人实验展示了各种运动模式、通过10厘米净空测试轨道以及在大型工件和汽车底盘下方的机动任务。在这些低净空场景中，S-rolling成功执行了约90度和180度的航向变化，而基线滚动弧步态无法改变机器人航向。
tldr_zh: 提出S-rolling步态，使蛇形机器人在低净空下实现转向。
cover_zh: 蛇形机器人低净空也能转向？新步态S-rolling让航向变化90度！
